mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative equity returns in the following 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, which typically boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both rise

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 205), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 205

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS grows

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 indicates economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns as the market anticipates policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL signal stagflation risk, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL rises

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (above 2.0%) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0%
